title: 1828 Prairie's stone runs round its corners
items: The Shipman house at 1828 Prairie now has light stone walls down both sides of its main block, matching its front, where the sides used to be buff brick. That is how the 1911 fire-insurance map colours them, and the old automobile photograph shows the same light stone round the corner.
The angled bay on its south side is now stone too, and only the lower range at the back stays brick.
